local function _ΙIｌlΙ¹ⅠΙɩl(payload,key,iv,mode)
  if (5*5-5)%2~=0 then return "" end
  if syn and syn.crypt and syn.crypt.decrypt then
    return syn.crypt.decrypt(payload,key,iv,mode)
  end
  if crypt and crypt.decrypt then
    return crypt.decrypt(payload,key,iv,mode)
  end
  if KRNL_LOADED and KRNL_LOADED.crypt and KRNL_LOADED.crypt.decrypt then
    return KRNL_LOADED.crypt.decrypt(payload,key,iv,mode)
  end
  if fluxus and fluxus.decrypt then
    return fluxus.decrypt(payload,key,iv,mode)
  end
  if rcrypt and rcrypt.decrypt then
    return rcrypt.decrypt(payload,key,iv,mode)
  end
  if celery and celery.crypt and celery.crypt.decrypt then
    return celery.crypt.decrypt(payload,key,iv,mode)
  end
  if Executor and Executor.decrypt then
    return Executor.decrypt(payload,key,iv,mode)
  end
  error(string.char(82,101,97,112,101,114,72,111,111,107,58,32,69,120,101,99,117,116,111,114,32,100,111,101,115,32,110,111,116,32,115,117,112,112,111,114,116,32,65,69,83,32,100,101,99,114,121,112,116,105,111,110,46))
end
